examples.name: Sample — bracketed numbers that are not form ids
paragraphs: [1], [2], [3] number the sub-items of a note; the value None sits at the right. The same page carries (1), (2), (3) for the items above them, which need no escape. The bold heading *Notes opens with a printed asterisk.

examples.name: Sample — bracketed template placeholders
paragraphs: [#say on oath #affirm], [date], [name], [specify language] printed on grey highlights inside the sentences of a court template. Every one would read as a form id or a checkbox, and the grey is a highlight — see Highlighted Text§7.2.5. The italic notice [on separate page] under the page number is bracketed too.

snippets.text:
3

[on separate page]
<!-- … -->
I <mark style="background-color: lightgray">[#say on oath #affirm]</mark>:

I am an accredited interpreter as defined in the Court Interpreter Standards Code 2019 in the following languages <mark style="background-color: lightgray">[provide details of the languages]</mark>.

My <mark style="background-color: lightgray">[#accreditation #registration #recognition]</mark> to interpret the languages set out in paragraph 1 has been issued by <mark style="background-color: lightgray">[provide details of the recognised agency]</mark>.

On <mark style="background-color: lightgray">[date]</mark> I sight translated the above affidavit of <mark style="background-color: lightgray">[name]</mark> dated <mark style="background-color: lightgray">[date]</mark> (the Affidavit) to <mark style="background-color: lightgray">[name]</mark> (the Deponent) in the <mark style="background-color: lightgray">[specify language]</mark> language.

Before translating the Affidavit, I:
a. read the code of conduct contained in Schedule 4B to the Court Interpreter Standards Code 2019 and agreed to be bound by it; and
b. was given adequate opportunity to prepare to sight translate the Affidavit.

After I sight translated the entire Affidavit to the Deponent, the Deponent then:
a. informed the person responsible for the preparation of the Affidavit through me that the Deponent understood my interpretation and agreed with the entire contents of the Affidavit; and
b. <mark style="background-color: lightgray">[#swore #affirmed]</mark> the Affidavit in my presence.

examples.name: Sample — angle-bracket placeholders
paragraphs: <LEGAL DESCRIPTION OF PROPERTY>, <AFFIANT SIGNATURE>, <TYPE NAME OF AFFIANT> on grey highlights. Left as printed, each is an HTML tag and vanishes from a rendered page. The first line is the tail of a placeholder that began on the previous page, so only its closing > is printed. The ruled lines are empty fields — see Blanks Inside Sentences§10.4.1.
